headline: Shipping Conviction, finishing Meridian, sharpening CEX.

blocks.title: Building
blocks.body: Conviction is live on devnet and I'm tightening the match flow — better edge cases, cleaner settlement, and the long tail of small UX details. Meridian is in clearance review ahead of the Anchor SDK cutover. CEX Demo is in polish mode: nicer charts, fewer race conditions in the settler worker.
items: Conviction — settlement edge cases and a quieter match screen
Meridian (Trevault / TVLT) — wiring Pyth + Switchboard oracles and the liquidation path
CEX Demo — chart ergonomics, settle endpoint slowness, phantom reconnection flow
BoST Portal at Softcom — onboarding the next batch of club maintainers

blocks.title: Learning
blocks.body: Working through Crafting Interpreters in Rust end-to-end — rewriting the Java tree-walker chapter in Rust and finding that half the lessons are about lifetimes, not parsers. Slowly working through a second pass of Designing Data-Intensive Applications.
items: Crafting Interpreters — rewriting chapters in Rust
Designing Data-Intensive Applications — second pass, with pen
Solana program security reading list (Neodyme + Trail of Bits writeups)
